label: HID Aero X1100 intelligent access controller
description: HID Aero X1100 is a two-door intelligent controller on HID Mercury technology, driving two Wiegand or four OSDP readers on-board and up to 64 readers with X100/X200/X300 expansion IO modules. It talks to the host over an on-board Ethernet 10-BaseT/100Base-TX port and is powered from 12-24 V DC.
notes: One Ethernet port (CAT-5, 100 m to the switch); the RS-485 ports to X100/X200/X300 IO modules and the reader ports are serial, not IP. Input voltage 12-24 V DC +/-10%, no PoE, so the unit needs its own supply in a cabinet. TLS 1.2 to host software, AES-256 to IO modules, OSDP secure channel to readers; UL 294 recognised component.
